job.job_description:
Elevati is looking for hands-on Generative AI Engineers who love solving real-world problems with automation and AI. If you enjoy experimenting with new tools, building scalable solutions, and seeing your work in action this role is for you.
Experience: 1 to 3 Years of experience in Generative AI
What You ll Work On
End-to-end automation and AI workflows using tools like Make.com, n8n, Zapier, Retool, Bubble, and LangChain
Deploying and fine-tuning LLMs (GPT-4, Claude, Mistral, LLaMA, etc.) for custom business applications
Building and integrating AI chatbots and assistants using RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), Vector DBs (Pinecone, Weaviate, Chroma)
Developing workflows with Twilio, Vapi, Voiceflow, Whisper, and speech-to-text APIs
Leveraging platforms like OpenAI, Hugging Face, Google Vertex AI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic
Working with PostgreSQL, Firebase, Supabase, MongoDB, and SQL/NoSQL
Front-end integrations with tools like Next.js, React, or Streamlit
Version control and deployments using GitHub, Docker, Railway, Render, Vercel, or Cloudflare Workers
What You Bring
Hands-on experience in automation platforms, LLM APIs, and low-code/no-code tools
Familiarity with prompt engineering, agent frameworks, and chaining models
Strong knowledge of APIs, webhooks, and full-stack development basics
Ability to work independently and take ownership of entire projects
Passion for AI, constant learning, and building innovative solutions
Bonus: Exposure to multi-modal AI, image/video generation, or agent-based architectures (AutoGen, CrewAI, LangGraph)
Why Join Elevati
Work on real, high-impact AI products
Freedom to innovate and experiment
Be part of a forward-thinking, fast-moving team
Office located in the heart of Punes tech hub Baner
